prompt: @higgsfield Build and deploy a polished, one-page 3D scrolling website for the product, service, or brand in the attached photo or link. Use strong creative judgment without asking unnecessary questions. Make scrolling drive a cinematic story: a central product or scene rotates, transforms, assembles, or reveals a before-and-after result. Choose a concept that demonstrates the offering’s value. Use pinned scenes, smooth camera movement, dramatic lighting, layered depth, bold typography, and fluid transitions. Create a distinctive visual identity suited to the brand, with custom imagery and purposeful motion. Include a compelling hero, benefits, relevant features or services, supplied social proof, and clear calls to action. Make navigation, buttons, and interactions functional. Never invent prices, reviews, statistics, or claims. Optimize for desktop and mobile, with fast loading, accessible text, reduced-motion support, and graceful visual fallbacks. Deliver a complete, premium website.
